asserted: aggregate mean over an ordinal-scaled satisfaction field
cause: the mean is not invariant under monotone transformation of an ordinal scale

asserted: aggregate mean over integer codes 1-5 that carry an ordinal scale, reported as a single number
cause: integer representation does not confer interval standing; the mean is not invariant under monotone transformation

asserted: ratio comparison (length from zero) on an interval-scaled temperature field
cause: a ratio is undefined without a meaningful zero

asserted: aggregate sum over an interval-scaled field
cause: a sum is not invariant under the affine transformations an interval scale admits

asserted: aggregate max over a nominal-scaled field
cause: an order statistic needs an order the scale does not have

asserted: linear aggregate mean over a cyclic-scaled hour-of-day field
cause: a cyclic scale needs a circular mean; the linear mean depends on where the period is cut
colloquial: average login hour of 23:00 and 01:00 is noon

asserted: aggregate sum over an identity field
cause: a key is not a quantity; no aggregate over it is meaningful

asserted: aggregate sum over an instant-temporality field
cause: instants are interval-scaled in time; only their differences, which are durations, are meaningful

asserted: aggregate sum over a semi-additive measure along its non-additive dimension
cause: the measure is declared non-additive along that dimension

asserted: partition then order along length on a semi-additive measure over its non-additive dimension
cause: the stack performs the sum the measure is declared not to admit along that dimension

asserted: normalize to a whole over a non-additive measure
cause: normalization presumes the parts sum to the whole

asserted: normalize then partition then order on a non-additive measure
cause: normalization presumes additivity the measure lacks

asserted: aggregate mean over a rate measure on rollup
cause: a rate must re-derive from its numerator and denominator at the new grain

asserted: join at cardinality one-to-many followed by sum on the one-side measure
cause: duplicated rows inflate the sum

asserted: join orders to order lines then count rows as orders
cause: the count is taken at the wrong grain after fan-out
colloquial: order count that equals line count

asserted: nest with subtotals not at a declared grain
cause: the subtotal derivation is undefined off the declared grain

asserted: aggregate sum over proportion-scaled values declared against different wholes
cause: proportions of different wholes are not additive
colloquial: market shares of two markets added

asserted: two positional channels in one coordinate space carrying different unit dimensions with no declared relation
cause: dimensional analysis fails across the shared space

asserted: layer of a single-row relation whose unit dimension differs from the axis it sits on
cause: dimensional analysis fails across the shared scale
colloquial: target line in the wrong unit

asserted: aggregate sum over a currency field declared with mixed units and no conversion rate
cause: values in different units are not summable

asserted: a proportion-scaled field with no declared whole
cause: the normalization base is absent

asserted: an index-scaled field without a declared base
cause: a rebased value has no referent

asserted: bin with no declared closure
cause: boundary membership is ambiguous

asserted: change-over-time task; connection across a not-applicable or censored null; no missing mechanism declared
cause: interpolation asserts a value that is not there

asserted: a diverging luminance scale with no declared midpoint
cause: the midpoint is a claim
colloquial: red/blue heat map with an arbitrary centre

asserted: a by-measure sort declared in style rather than as a derivation
cause: ordering is semantic

asserted: layer with an undeclared unshared positional scale in one coordinate space
cause: marks in one space imply one scale

asserted: facet with no declared shared or free scale policy per channel
cause: cross-facet comparability is a claim

asserted: bin with unequal widths; count encoded to length
cause: the area-density invariant is violated

asserted: an interval-temporality field encoded to a point position
cause: the extent is lost without a declared lossy step

asserted: a field with interval uncertainty projected to a point mark with no lossy-admissible classification
cause: the loss is unstated

asserted: aggregate sum over values with declared measurement error yielding a result with no uncertainty and no lossy classification
cause: an aggregate over uncertain values must carry the uncertainty or declare the loss

asserted: a log axis transform on a ratio field whose rows contain zero or non-positive values
cause: the transform is undefined at those values
colloquial: log axis that swallows the zeros

asserted: a log axis transform under a composition task with partition then order along length
cause: additivity of lengths is lost under the transform

asserted: a derivation that coerces suppressed or absent nulls to the value zero before aggregation or encoding
cause: a missing value is not a measured zero; the null kind is collapsed without a declared mechanism

asserted: aggregate mean over rows whose values include censored observations treated as measured
cause: a censored value is a bound, not a measurement
colloquial: average survival time including the still-alive

asserted: union of two series at different temporal grains with no aggregate-to-grain
cause: values at different grains are not co-registered
colloquial: daily and monthly series on one axis

asserted: a nominal field encoded to angle in a polar coordinate space
cause: angle is licensed by a cyclic scale or a composition invariant only

asserted: an interval-scaled field encoded to area
cause: area carries ratio only

asserted: an ordinal field encoded to hue
cause: hue is nominal-capacity and cannot carry order

asserted: a nominal field encoded to a sequential luminance ramp
cause: a sequential ramp implies an order the scale does not have

asserted: a nominal distinction carried on hue alone with no redundant channel
cause: the distinction is not conserved under hue loss

asserted: an identity field encoded to hue or area
cause: keys are not categories

asserted: layout-generated position under a correlation or magnitude-comparison task
cause: layout-generated geometry carries no claim
colloquial: reading distance off a force layout

asserted: magnitude-comparison task reading absolute position where the baseline is layout-generated
cause: layout-generated geometry carries no claim; only thickness is readable

asserted: magnitude-comparison task; length channel; baseline not at zero
cause: the ratio-comparability invariant is violated

asserted: length channel from a truncated baseline with the task declared as lookup-rollup
cause: the encoding induces a magnitude-comparison claim the declared task cannot disavow
colloquial: it is just a lookup, ignore the heights

asserted: composition task over parts that do not cover the declared whole
cause: composition requires an exhaustive partition

asserted: composition task over non-exclusive parts
cause: overlapping parts double-count the whole

asserted: graph with conserved flow whose edge values violate conservation at a non-terminal node; no leakage declared
cause: the conservation invariant fails on the rows

asserted: partition then order along length on a measure with negative values and no declared split
cause: stacked lengths do not sum to the total

asserted: embed serving a magnitude-comparison task with no baseline channel in the cell
cause: the task invariant is unsatisfiable within the channel budget

asserted: magnitude-comparison task reading area in a geographic coordinate space with no declared equal-area projection
cause: the map projection distorts area, so area carries no ratio
colloquial: comparing countries by size on a Mercator map

asserted: visual sorted by measure; navigational projection traverses intrinsic order
cause: the ordering derivation is not shared across projections
colloquial: a11y reads A to Z, the visual shows rank

asserted: aggregate-to-grain over a relation whose grain is declared unknown
cause: without a grain, duplicates and fan-out are undetectable, so the rollup is neither proven legal nor proven illegal
colloquial: sum of a table nobody knows the key of

asserted: aggregate sum over a currency field whose unit is per-row, before any rows are seen
cause: whether the rows mix units is an instance fact; the sum is admissible only once the rows are shown commensurable
colloquial: revenue total before we know which currencies are in it

asserted: aggregate sum over a field whose type permits suppressed nulls, before any rows are seen
cause: whether any row is suppressed is an instance fact, and the mechanism for treating one is undeclared
colloquial: total that may or may not include suppressed cells

asserted: graph declared with conserved flow, before any edge values are seen
cause: conservation is a property of the edge values, not of the declaration
colloquial: flow diagram declared balanced, not yet checked

asserted: a log axis transform on a ratio field whose rows are not yet seen
cause: the transform is admissible only on a positive domain, which is an instance fact
colloquial: log axis on data that might contain zeros
